## EA Media Tools 2.5.1 - jaguar

### H.264 preset defaults

- Archive and Regular now select H.264 by default, with the High output profile defined in `presets.ini`.
- H.264 maximum rates at 1080p are 10000 kbps for Archive, 8000 kbps for Regular, 6500 kbps for Streaming, and 7000 kbps for Music Video.
- H.264 maximum rates at 720p and 360p/Cellular are 4000 kbps.
- Regular and Streaming use P4 for H.264 at 4K and 1080p; Music Video uses P6. Their 720p and 360p H.264 outputs use P2, while Archive retains P6.
- Existing buffer multipliers are unchanged.

### Preset configuration

- `presets.ini` now supports codec-and-tier-specific encoder speed, target bitrate, and maximum-rate overrides.
- H.264 output profiles are data-driven instead of being hardcoded to the Music Video workflow.
- Archive's bitrate-control availability now follows the validated `bitrate_control` preset field, allowing its configured maximum rate to be emitted.

[Review changes since v2.5.0](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v2.5.0...v2.5.1).
